title: MorphingNet: Symbolic Regression Where the Network Is the Formula
abstract: arXiv:2610.19942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce MorphingNet, a network for symbolic regression (SR) whose units change their function continuously. Instead of searching over expressions built from a fixed operator library, MorphingNet trains the form of each function as a parameter, so SR becomes one continuous optimization problem. Its units are either pole-free rational functions or complex exponential--logarithm functions, which move between exponentials, sinusoids, damped oscillations, power laws and logarithms as their parameters change. The network is a readable formula at every step of training, and no operator library is needed to train it; a structure-recovery step afterwards rewrites the trained formula into short elementary expressions. Training is dense linear algebra, so it is GPU-friendly and scales to large data. translated_title: MorphingNet：网络即公式的符号回归
translated_abstract: 我们提出了MorphingNet，一种用于符号回归（SR）的网络，其单元可以连续地改变自身的函数形式。MorphingNet不再基于固定算子库构建的表达式进行搜索，而是将每个函数的形式本身作为参数进行训练，从而使符号回归成为一个连续优化问题。其单元要么是无极点有理函数，要么是复指数-对数函数，随着参数的变化，它们可以在指数函数、正弦函数、阻尼振荡、幂律和对数函数之间平滑转换。该网络在训练的每一步都是一个可读的公式，且训练过程无需算子库；随后的结构恢复步骤会将训练好的公式重写为简短的基本初等表达式。训练过程仅为稠密线性代数运算，因此对GPU友好，并可扩展到大规模数据。MorphingNet在SRBench上达到了最先进的精度，在合成基准上恢复了大多数生成公式，在大规模数据上性能最高可提升至……（原文截断）。
tldr: MorphingNet将每个函数的形式本身作为可训练参数，把符号回归转化为连续优化问题，无需算子库即可在训练全程保持公式可读，并在SRBench上达到最先进精度。
en_tdlr: MorphingNet turns symbolic regression into a continuous optimization problem by treating each function's form as a trainable parameter, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy on SRBench without an operator library while keeping the network a readable formula throughout training.
